description: NaWO₂PO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.18 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-50°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-44°. There is one shorter (1.53 Å) and three longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one W, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one W, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one W, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one W, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one W, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one W and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one W and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one W and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom.
